notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list places Kennedy Hill; it gives location, county and elevation only, with no construction, staffing, status or access data. The entry is named 'kennedy hill' without the 'Lookout Tower' suffix that most entries carry, so the list may not identify it as a lookout; the brief's kind 'tower' is unverified. The elevation column is read as feet (the list's Brasstown Lookout Tower reads 4735, which fits feet) and matches the brief's 69.8 m. A search snippet suggested Catledge Hill might be the same site; the coordinates (30.919 vs 30.700, roughly 15 miles apart) show they are separate entries, so the story treats them as separate. A search for Kennedy Hill in Quitman turned up only property and place-name pages, which were not used. Access and current condition unknown.
